agent.goal_source: Public three-part improvement proposal approved by the user.
agent.attribution_source: Session identifies the GPT-6 family and Codex desktop. Canonical model ID, exact harness version and reasoning controls are not exposed; no subagents were used.

usage.notes: Per-attempt usage telemetry is not exposed.

time.notes: Agent/human telemetry is unavailable. No candidate RTL build, benchmark simulation, synthesis study, or physical measurement was performed. Direct command durations, lab smoke tests, and native-reference fixture durations are measured separately in the retained artifacts.

cost.notes: Billing telemetry and a pinned price source are unavailable.

execution.working_tree: clean at committed-tests, known-good and broken evaluator fixture runs, and detached reproduction
execution.scope: Trusted trace-tool maintenance, shared provenance artifact verification, and portable CI checks. Hardware candidates and evaluator correctness rules are unchanged.
execution.dependency_notes: actionlint 1.7.12 built locally with Go into ignored runs storage. The independent schema checker used the prior ignored jsonschema virtualenv. Runtime tools and normal tests remain standard-library-only. Linux checks used an isolated container with a read-only source snapshot and networking disabled; the image digest is in image-identity artifacts.
execution.commands_note: Each trace attempt has its own immutable-in-practice command.json plus stdout/stderr. Early baseline checks use capture.py with equivalent exit-status and timing records. The aggregate commands.json is not hashed because further trace attempts append to it.

result.remote_ci_notes: Workflow is committed but has not been pushed or run on GitHub. Linux container checks exercised the same four check commands, not the hosted Actions services.
limitations: Artifact verification is opt-in and checks evidence entries only. Null-path reports remain unverified.
Generated run artifacts are local and Git-ignored. Restore them and use the recorded checkout to verify this record.
The aggregate trace index uses Unix flock; supported hosts are macOS and Linux.
A matching trusted manifest cannot by itself approve coordinated changes to protected code and hashes; trusted maintenance still needs review.
